wins.text: Worldwide Q1 sales of $21.4B, up 3.9% reported; ex-COVID vaccine operational growth of 7.6% worldwide; adjusted diluted EPS of $2.71, up 12.4% YoY
DARZALEX grew 21% driven by 6-point share gains across all lines and 10-point gains in frontline; ERLEADA grew 28.4%; TREMFYA grew 27.6%; SPRAVATO grew 72% YoY
CARVYKTI achieved $157M in Q1 vs. $72M in Q1 2023 (>100% YoY growth); received FDA approval for 2nd-line setting, expanding addressable market significantly
Electrophysiology delivered 25.9% growth with double-digit gains in all regions; Abiomed grew 15%; EP business nearing $5B in revenue growing >20%
Board authorized 4.2% dividend increase, marking 62nd consecutive year of dividend increases; free cash flow of ~$3B in Q1, above prior year

risks.text: STELARA biosimilar entry anticipated in Europe midyear 2024 expected to weigh on H2 Innovative Medicine growth; volume growth largely offset by price declines going forward
IMBRUVICA sales declining due to competitive pressures; XARELTO facing unfavorable patient mix expected to continue throughout the year; REMICADE/SIMPONI European distribution rights returned in Q4
Contact Lens segment declined 2.3% due to U.S. distributor inventory destocking; China VBP pressuring Surgery and Surgical Vision segments
IRA drug price negotiation provisions described as 'damaging to the healthcare innovative system'; ongoing negotiations on selected drugs create pricing uncertainty
INVEGA SUSTENNA patent litigation remanded back to New Jersey District Court after Federal Circuit ruling; outcome uncertain despite management confidence in patent strength

guidance_items.detail: Full-year operational sales growth tightened to 5.5%-6.0%, or $88.7B-$89.1B; midpoint raised by $300M vs. prior guidance; reported sales growth 4.7%-5.2% after ~$700M FX headwind
Adjusted operational EPS range tightened to $10.60-$10.75, midpoint raised $0.03 to $10.68, reflecting 7.7% YoY growth; reported adjusted EPS unchanged at $10.65 due to $0.03 FX headwind
Interest income guidance raised to $550M-$650M from prior range
Shockwave acquisition expected to dilute adjusted EPS by ~$0.10 in 2024 upon closing (guidance to be updated at close)
